mechanism_narrative: Monotone four-week deterioration in TRANSIT (-67.1 to -75.6) and WORKPLACES (-31.1 to -45.6) shows out-of-home trip chains still contracting; because retail footfall monetizes those same chains, RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell from -39.9 to -56.4 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Next-28-day mean RETAIL_REC is at or above the last-28-day mean of -46.8 in a window where TRANSIT and WORKPLACES each declined week-on-week for four consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT crosses below -75 percent of baseline, the crossing marks a binding policy tightening that removes discretionary trips; retail visits follow transit trips down within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses below -75 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell to -75.6 at t-0w, its first reading below -75
failure_condition: In the week following a TRANSIT crossing below -75, the weekly RETAIL_REC mean is equal to or higher than the week before the crossing.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RESIDENTIAL (21.7 to 23.3) together with falling WORKPLACES (-39.6 to -45.6) keeps daytime population at home and removes commuter-window shopping trips; the joint move lowers RETAIL_REC over two weeks even if either series alone stabilizes.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL four-week mean above 20.0 while WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose to 23.3 while WORKPLACES fell to -45.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL stays above 20.0 and WORKPLACES continues declining week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The week-on-week fall in RETAIL_REC decelerated from -10.3 points to -5.8 points between t-1w and t-0w, indicating the demand shock is exhausting itself; adaptive behavior and pent-up demand lift RETAIL_REC above its last-28-day mean within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC week-on-week change improves by at least 4 points after a prior decline of 10 points or more
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls by more than 5 points per week for two further weeks after the observed deceleration.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM is the highest-frequency remaining out-of-home trip; its drop from -13.0 to -24.1 shows routine errands are being cut, and that suppression transmits into discretionary retail visits within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell 11.1 points between t-3w and t-0w
failure_condition: The weekly RETAIL_REC mean is flat or higher in the week immediately after a GROCERY_PHARM decline of more than 4 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS falling from -35.3 to -43.3 as the season turns removes a complementary outdoor trip that anchors weekend retail and dining excursions; losing park visits drains retail footfall for the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 8.0 points between t-2w and t-0w while RETAIL_REC fell 5.8 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS stays at or below -43.3 percent change from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL above 22 percent of baseline combined with TRANSIT below -73 signals an enforced stay-at-home regime in which retail capacity is cut by mandate rather than by choice, so RETAIL_REC declines further over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean rises above 22.0 while TRANSIT falls below -73.0
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL reached 23.3 while TRANSIT fell to -75.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days exceeds its last-14-day mean while RESIDENTIAL stays above 22.0 and TRANSIT below -73.0.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS recovers more than 8 points from its four-week trough of -52.3, that recovery signals relaxation of outdoor restrictions and leads retail footfall by about four weeks, pushing RETAIL_REC above its last-28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises more than 8 points above its four-week trough of -52.3
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS swung from -52.3 to -35.3 to -43.3, showing sensitivity to outdoor mobility conditions
failure_condition: After PARKS rises more than 8 points above its trough, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC remains below its last-28-day mean.
